overview: The Commission for Persons with Disabilities approved the May meeting minutes and discussed potential scheduling adjustments for future disability fairs. Director of Traffic and Transportation Todd Blake presented updates on pedestrian signal accessibility upgrades and proposed MBTA bus route changes.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the minutes from the May meeting.

items.title: Disability Fair Timing Discussion
items.summary: The commission reviewed proposals to adjust the event hours or move the fair to the fall, deciding to revisit the schedule when planning resumes in the autumn.

items.title: ADA Transition Plan and IHCD Survey Updates
items.summary: Nicholas Karinge reported that the Institute for Human Centered Design completed an accessibility survey of City Hall and noted that the city applied for an implementation grant.

items.title: Traffic, Accessible Pedestrian Signals, and Bus Route Updates
items.summary: Director of Traffic and Transportation Todd Blake detailed plans to install accessible pedestrian signal buttons at multiple intersections and discussed ongoing advocacy regarding MBTA bus routes 80, 94, and 96.
